Multiverse Computing and Qualcomm have announced a partnership to deliver more energy‑efficient AI models for data‑center use. The collaboration combines Qualcomm’s hardware acceleration with Multiverse Computing’s software solutions, aiming to reduce power consumption while maintaining performance levels. The initiative supports enterprise data centers in scaling AI workloads more cost‑effectively.
